🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Hayley Williams announces 2027 UK and European run

Hayley Williams has confirmed the UK and European leg of The Hayley Williams Show for June and July 2027, her first solo headline run at arena and amphitheatre scale on the continent. The route starts in Milan on 7 June and ends at London's Alexandra Palace on 2 July.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: blink-182 headline Download Festival 2027

Download Festival has revealed the first lineup wave for its 2027 edition, with blink-182, Bring Me The Horizon and Evanescence as headliners. It will be blink-182's first appearance at Download. Pierce The Veil are also confirmed for the festival at Donington Park.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Fake Names announce first European tour

Punk supergroup Fake Names, with Brian Baker, Dennis Lyxzen of Refused and Johnny Temple in the line-up, will play four German shows in early 2027. Their third album Punk Ruins came out on 23 October 2026 via Epitaph Records.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Blackout Problems announce HEAL and 2027 tour

Munich band Blackout Problems have announced their fifth studio album HEAL, due in April 2027 with eleven songs. The tour has eight dates, starting in Vienna on 11 March and covering six German cities from Berlin on 8 April to Hannover on 17 April.
